summary: Rev A after datasheet verification. All three blocking items from the previous review are closed. (1) TPS61022 checked against the TI datasheet: pinout, VREF 585-615 mV, MODE low = PFM, L/CIN/COUT ranges and R2 < 300k all match; 732k/100k is TI's own typical-application divider. The check found real issue A below (true load disconnect), now fixed. (2) Encoder replaced by Alps EC12D1524403 (-40..+85 C, automotive). (3) Every MPN verified against distributor/manufacturer listings, with 4 non-existent capacitor codes corrected. This added real fixes: issue B (PAM8302AADCR is SO-8, not MSOP-8 -> PAM8302AASCR), issue C (JST SH only -25 C -> Molex PicoBlade -40 C), and issue D (a generic 2835 LED on the KiCad footprint would have been mounted reversed; Broadcom's large pad is the anode). Board 80x48 mm: ERC 0, DRC 0 errors / 0 unconnected, checks pass, every power net at target width (only a 2.2 mm VSYS pad-entry neck when present), all 4 sims pass incl. LED min-Vf corner 153 mA < 200 mA. Still CONDITIONAL rather than PASS: two footprints (EC12D, Broadcom LED) were drawn from datasheet figures and need a 1:1 print / sample test-fit, and the FPC connector has no LCSC stock.

findings.title: AI-drawn footprints need a physical check
findings.detail: SW6 aipcb_custom:Alps_EC12D_Switch_Vertical was read off the Alps catalog p.289 drawing No.5: A/B 11.1 apart, A-C 8.3, D (5.95, 3.45), E 6.85, 5x d1.05, lugs 2.05x2.15. A/C y = +/-4.15 is inferred from symmetry (only the 8.3 span is dimensioned). D4 aipcb_custom:LED_Broadcom_2835_DFN2 follows Fig.12 exactly (2.49/1.42 x 2.10, 4.50 span, large pad = anode). Before ordering, print the copper layer 1:1 and set real parts on it, or get the Alps detailed drawing.

findings.title: Issue A fixed: TPS61022 has true load disconnect
findings.detail: The datasheet states the output is disconnected in shutdown, so with BOOST_EN low PAM8302 is unpowered. AMP_SD_N from the AP now goes through R40 10k (R40/R34 = 3.0 V when powered), which limits ESD-diode current to < 0.3 mA. Firmware order: BOOST_EN -> 2 ms -> AMP_SD_N.

findings.title: Issues B/C/D fixed during BOM verification
findings.detail: B: PAM8302AADCR is SO-8 (Diodes ordering table); changed to PAM8302AASCR / symbol PAM8302AAS for the MSOP-8 land. fm_radio U8 has the same MPN/footprint mismatch (its LCSC C113367 is the AASCR); fix its MPN text. C: JST SH SM02B-SRSS-TB is rated -25..+85 C; J2/J3/J4 changed to Molex PicoBlade 53261-0271 (-40 C, 1 A/contact; speaker rms 0.79 A). D: KiCad LED_PLCC_2835 pad 1 (large) = K, but the Broadcom CSMW-LR00-ATV0E large pad is the anode; a dedicated footprint now has pad 2 = A.

findings.title: SOS hardware 3 s qualifier tolerance (unchanged)
findings.detail: 2.14-3.98 s over the 74AUP1G17 VT+ spread, plus X8R and leakage. Backup/wake path only; firmware must enforce the 3 s hold on SOS_PRESS.

findings.title: Board 1 interface requirements
findings.detail: +3V3 on the FPC must be always-on. DNP R1/R2 if Board 1 pulls I2C up. I2C map: 0x21 TCA9554, 0x70 TCA9546A, 0x5A x2 behind CH0/CH1. FPC pin map is in J1's description.

findings.title: Router / engine changes made for this board
findings.detail: Flanked GND pins are fanned out inward first. Fan-outs that would strand neighbouring signals are rolled back, with a trace-to-GND fallback. Power nets neck down per connection instead of the whole net. Open GND pins count as routing failures when scoring passes. New rules: net_widths, route_passes, stitch_pitch. New custom footprint types tht/pads, and the checks flag AI-drawn footprints. fm_radio uses only defaults but has not been rebuilt since; rebuild it once.

findings.title: Mechanical / assembly
findings.detail: The board is now 80x48 mm (was 46) to fit the PicoBlade speaker connector. The placer reports 1.38 overlap from its own 0.4 mm spacing margin around J4/H3; KiCad courtyard DRC is clean. Not yet done: enclosure CAD alignment for key pitch 13.5 mm, encoder/SOS/LED positions; test points; conformal-coating keep-outs on the assembly drawing.
